titles.title: From the Ends of the Earth

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
From the ends of the earth
You’ll hear our song
Glory to the Righteous One

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Every nation, tongue, and tribe
Will be to You a spotless bride
And this song that we now raise
Is hastening the day

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
You will have Your inheritance, Jesus
Starting with my heart

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Hallelujah, our Bridegroom is coming
Hallelujah, He will reign

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Spirit and the bride say, "Come"
Spirit and the bride say, "Come and reign"

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Desire of the nations
You will come to us
Hope of creation
You will come to us
